text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Losing weight starts with food. If I make 
wild mountain greens my staple diet, 
surely...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
“—Though I say that, they really don't 
grow around here like they do back 
home...”

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
No, I can't give up over somethin' like 
this! If I put my back into it, I'm sure 
to find it!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Found it, didn't I?! Time to harvest, 
harvest~♪

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
If we look around here, we might find all 
sorts of other things. All right, one more 
push!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Phew! If you look around, there's quite a 
lot out here. With this, our wild 
vegetable dishes are gonna turn out 
amazing!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"...Whoops, it's pitch black out already!? 
I gotta hurry on home!"

And so, thanks to foraging and cooking 
wild vegetables, Yukino Bijin successfully 
lost weight.
